A crash while logging a session is fixed, sheets no longer show the page through them, and Dutch text no longer gets squeezed.
A deck of 157 cards in English and Dutch: challenges, duels, votes, questions, charades, debates and table rules, with your names on them. Play full screen, card after card.

Decarboxylation turns THCA into THC. Spread ground flower thinly on baking paper and keep the oven below 125 °C to protect terpenes. Oven thermostats vary, so an oven thermometer helps.

Deleting Taima deletes everything in it, so keep a backup. Backups are protected with your passphrase. Leaving Taima out of iCloud backups keeps your records off Apple\'s servers, but then only your own backups can bring them back.

Discreet mode switches to a plain notes icon and keeps strain names and photos off widgets, the Live Activity, notifications and the app switcher. The name under the icon stays Taima.
Don\'t drive or use machinery after using. THC slows reactions, and Dutch law sets strict limits.
Don\'t use when pregnant or breastfeeding.
Effects take 30 to 90 minutes and last longer. Wait before taking more; the edible timer can help.
Eight questions about the past 6 months. Your answers stay on this iPhone; only the score is kept so you can compare later.
Every bag, photo, session, note, wishlist item, learned grower and setting is removed from this iPhone. Backups you already exported are not touched.
Every card rewritten, from light warm-ups to questions that go deeper as the night goes on. Cards you played before wait until the rest have had a turn.
Every curated lineage now shows where it comes from. Growers and sources update with the strain library.
Every game is in a library under the spin. Start one, deal new prompts, pass the turn and keep score.
